# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
```

# Specify function

```{r}
select <- dplyr::select
```

# Correlation

## Age

```{r}
cor_results <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  select(DAid, Age = `Age (baseline)`) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(DAid, Age), names_to = "Assay", values_to = "Value") |>
  group_by(Assay) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(Age, Value, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p = -log10(pval)
  ) |>
  select(Assay, Correlation, pval, neglog10p)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(cor_results, aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Assay), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman rho",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    title = "Volcano plot of Age vs protein correlations (Spearman)"
  )
```

## CD4/CD8

### Baseline & Follow-up

```{r}
cor_results <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == "Baseline") |>
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>
  select(DAid, baseline_value = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`, fu_value = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(DAid, baseline_value, fu_value), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value") |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(baseline_value, Value, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p = -log10(pval)
  ) |>
  select(Assay, Correlation, pval, neglog10p)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(cor_results, aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Assay), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman rho",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    title = "Volcano plot of Age vs protein correlations (Spearman)"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare correlation data
# ---------------------------
cor_results <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  select(
    DAid,
    baseline_value = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    fu_value       = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Metadata"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Metadata), !is.na(Protein)) |>
  group_by(Feature, Timepoint) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(Metadata, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p   = -log10(pval),
    Timepoint   = recode(
      Timepoint,
      baseline_value = "Baseline",
      fu_value       = "Follow-up"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Feature, Timepoint, Correlation, pval, neglog10p)

ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p, color = Timepoint)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = cor_results |> filter(pval < 1e-4),
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Baseline"  = "#E94849",
      "Follow-up" = "#5F98C6"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation (rho)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = "Timepoint",
    title = "Protein correlations with CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Baseline vs Follow-up (HIV, excluding Elite Controllers)"
  )


```

#### Unadjusted

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare correlation data
# ---------------------------
cor_results <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  select(
    DAid,
    baseline_value = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    fu_value       = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Metadata"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Metadata), !is.na(Protein)) |>
  group_by(Feature, Timepoint) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(Metadata, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p   = -log10(pval),
    Timepoint   = recode(
      Timepoint,
      baseline_value = "Baseline",
      fu_value       = "Follow-up"
    ),
    sig_class   = if_else(pval < 0.05, Timepoint, "Not significant")
  ) |>
  select(Feature, Timepoint, Correlation, pval, neglog10p, sig_class)

# ---------------------------
# Label top ± correlations (raw p < 0.05)
# ---------------------------
label_df <- cor_results |>
  filter(pval < 0.05) |>
  group_by(Timepoint) |>
  arrange(desc(Correlation)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    cor_results |>
      filter(pval < 0.05) |>
      group_by(Timepoint) |>
      arrange(Correlation) |>
      slice_head(n = 10)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(Feature, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Volcano plot (RAW p-values)
# ---------------------------
ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p, color = sig_class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # Raw p-value threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype   = "dashed",
    colour     = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    colour     = "grey50"
  ) +

  # Label top ± correlations
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Baseline"        = "#E94849",
      "Follow-up"       = "#5F98C6",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation (rho)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = "Timepoint",
    title = "Protein correlations with CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Raw p-values (no multiple testing correction)"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "Protein correlations with CD4CD8 raw pvalues.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Protein correlations with CD4CD8 raw pvalues.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)
```

#### Adjusted

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare correlation data
# ---------------------------
cor_results <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  select(
    DAid,
    baseline_value = `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    fu_value       = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(baseline_value, fu_value),
    names_to = "Timepoint",
    values_to = "Metadata"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Metadata), !is.na(Protein)) |>
  group_by(Feature, Timepoint) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(Metadata, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    Timepoint   = recode(
      Timepoint,
      baseline_value = "Baseline",
      fu_value       = "Follow-up"
    )
  ) |>
  # 🔑 BH correction PER TIMEPOINT
  group_by(Timepoint) |>
  mutate(
    adj_pval  = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    neglog10q = -log10(adj_pval)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Feature, Timepoint, Correlation, pval, adj_pval, neglog10q)

cor_results <- cor_results |>
  mutate(
    sig_class = if_else(adj_pval < 0.05, Timepoint, "Not significant")
  )

label_df <- cor_results |>
  group_by(Timepoint) |>
  arrange(desc(Correlation)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    cor_results |>
      group_by(Timepoint) |>
      arrange(Correlation) |>
      slice_head(n = 10)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(adj_pval < 0.05)



```

```{r}

  ) +

  # 🔑 Label top ± significant correlations
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
```

## Delta CD4/CD8

### Baseline & Follow-up

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Compute Δ(CD4/CD8) per ID
# ---------------------------
delta_df <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  select(
    ID,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`)
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`
  ) |>
  select(ID, delta_cd4cd8)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Extract BASELINE protein samples
# ---------------------------
baseline_proteins <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Timepoint == "Baseline"
  ) |>
  select(DAid, ID) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  inner_join(delta_df, by = "ID")

# ---------------------------
# 4. Select top ± correlations for labeling
# ---------------------------
label_df <- cor_results |>
  arrange(desc(abs(Correlation))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Volcano plot
# ---------------------------
ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10q, color = sig_class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation with Δ(CD4/CD8)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Baseline proteins correlated with change in CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Δ = Follow-up − Baseline"
  )
```

#### Unadjusted

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Compute Δ(CD4/CD8) per ID
# ---------------------------
delta_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  select(
    ID,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`)
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`
  ) |>
  select(ID, delta_cd4cd8)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Extract BASELINE protein samples
# ---------------------------
baseline_proteins <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Timepoint == "Baseline",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  select(DAid, ID) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  inner_join(delta_df, by = "ID")

# ---------------------------
# 3. Correlation analysis (RAW p-values)
# ---------------------------
cor_results <- baseline_proteins |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, ID, delta_cd4cd8),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Protein), !is.na(delta_cd4cd8)) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(delta_cd4cd8, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p   = -log10(pval),
    sig_class   = if_else(pval < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "Not significant")
  )

# ---------------------------
# 4. Select top ± correlations for labeling
# ---------------------------
label_df_up <- cor_results |>
  arrange(desc(Correlation)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

label_df_down <- cor_results |>
  arrange(Correlation) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

label_df <- bind_rows(label_df_up, label_df_down)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Volcano plot (RAW p-values)
# ---------------------------
ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p, color = sig_class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +

    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "p < 0.05"        = "#D55E00",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation with Δ(CD4/CD8)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Baseline proteins correlated with change in CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Δ = Follow-up − Baseline (raw p-values, exploratory)"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "Baseline proteins vs delta CD4CD8 raw pvalues.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Baseline proteins vs delta CD4CD8 raw pvalues.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)
```

#### Adjusted

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Compute Δ(CD4/CD8) per ID
# ---------------------------
delta_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  select(
    ID,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,
    `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`),
    !is.na(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`)
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`
  ) |>
  select(ID, delta_cd4cd8)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Extract BASELINE protein samples
# ---------------------------
baseline_proteins <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Timepoint == "Baseline",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  select(DAid, ID) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  inner_join(delta_df, by = "ID")

# ---------------------------
# 3. Correlation analysis (BH-adjusted)
# ---------------------------
cor_results <- baseline_proteins |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, ID, delta_cd4cd8),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Protein), !is.na(delta_cd4cd8)) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(delta_cd4cd8, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    adj_pval  = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"),
    neglog10q = -log10(adj_pval),
    sig_class = if_else(adj_pval < 0.05, "FDR < 0.05", "Not significant")
  )

# ---------------------------
# 4. Select top ± significant correlations for labeling
# ---------------------------
label_df <- cor_results |>
  filter(adj_pval < 0.05) |>
  arrange(desc(Correlation)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    cor_results |>
      filter(adj_pval < 0.05) |>
      arrange(Correlation) |>
      slice_head(n = 10)
  ) |>
  distinct(Feature, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Volcano plot (BH-adjusted)
# ---------------------------
p <- ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10q, color = sig_class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype   = "dashed",
    colour     = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    colour     = "grey50"
  ) +

  # Labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "FDR < 0.05"      = "#D55E00",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +

  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation with Δ(CD4/CD8)",
    y = "-log10(FDR-adjusted p-value)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Baseline proteins correlated with change in CD4/CD8 ratio",
    subtitle = "Δ = Follow-up − Baseline (BH-adjusted, HIV only)"
  )

print(p)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "Baseline_proteins_vs_delta_CD4CD8_BH.png",
  plot     = p,
  path     = "../plots/png/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Baseline_proteins_vs_delta_CD4CD8_BH.pdf",
  plot     = p,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/correlation/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7
)
```


# Examples

```{r}
scatter_data <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>
  # Get delta CD4/CD8
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`
  ) |>
  select(DAid, delta_cd4cd8, Subcategory) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(-c(DAid, delta_cd4cd8, Subcategory), names_to = "Assay", values_to = "Value") |>
  filter(Assay %in% c("DUOX2", "CXCL13", "BST2", "GZMA", "FCRL2", "SLAMF7"))

ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = delta_cd4cd8, y = Value, color = Subcategory)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, aes(fill = Subcategory), alpha = 0.20) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = delta_cd4cd8, y = Value)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Delta CD4/CD8 ratio (Follow-up - Baseline)",
    y = "Protein level (NPX)",
    title = "Age vs protein correlations in HIV (Baseline)"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Assay, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_hiv()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)

scatter_data <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subcategory != "Elite Controller"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    delta_cd4cd8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`
  ) |>
  select(DAid, delta_cd4cd8, Subcategory) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(DAid, delta_cd4cd8, Subcategory),
    names_to = "Assay",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Assay %in% c("DUOX2", "CXCL13", "BST2", "GZMA", "FCRL2", "SLAMF7"),
    !is.na(delta_cd4cd8),
    !is.na(Value)
  )


ggplot(
  scatter_data,
  aes(x = delta_cd4cd8, y = Value, color = Subcategory)
) +
  # Points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +

  # Subgroup-specific regression (colored)
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    aes(fill = Subcategory),
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +

  # Overall regression (black)
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = delta_cd4cd8, y = Value)
  ) +

  # 🔑 Spearman rho per subgroup (nicely placed)
  ggpubr::stat_cor(
    aes(label = paste0("rho = ", ..r.label..)),
    method = "spearman",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Assay, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +

  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme_hiv() +
  guides(fill = "none") +

  labs(
    x = "Δ CD4/CD8 ratio (Follow-up − Baseline)",
    y = "Protein level (NPX)",
    color = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    title = "Baseline protein levels vs longitudinal CD4/CD8 change",
    subtitle = "Colored lines = subgroup-specific trends; black = overall trend"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "Baseline_proteins_vs_delta_CD4CD8_subgroups.png",

)

ggsave(
```

# Compare clinical and proteomic markers

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)

# 1. Get top 10 proteins from SII vs Healthy
top_proteins <- sii_healthy_de_res %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Feature)

# 2. Get NPX values for SII samples for those top proteins
npx_matrix <- data_long %>%
  filter(Assay %in% top_proteins) %>%
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
  filter(Subcategory == "Severely impaired immunity") %>%
  select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Assay, values_from = NPX)

# 3. Add numerical metadata (merge by DAid)
meta_numeric <- metadata %>%
  filter(Subcategory == "Severely impaired immunity") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric), DAid) %>%
  distinct()

# 4. Join NPX + metadata
combined <- inner_join(npx_matrix, meta_numeric, by = "DAid") %>%
  select(-DAid)

# 5. Remove columns with all NAs or constant values
valid_combined <- combined %>%
  select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 1)) %>%        # At least 2 non-NA values
  select(where(~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))       # Must vary

# 6. Compute correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(valid_combined, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

# 7. Plot correlation matrix
ggcorrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  hc.order = TRUE,
  type = "lower",
  lab = TRUE,
  lab_size = 2.5,
  colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"),
  title = "Correlation: Top SII Proteins vs Clinical Metadata",
  ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)

```

```{r ,figwidth=24, fig.height=20}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Define subcategories
subcat_levels <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Elite Controller"
)

# 2. Select top 10 proteins (from SII vs healthy)
top_proteins <- sii_healthy_de_res %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Feature)

# 3. Function to build cleaned correlation data
get_correlation_data <- function(subcat, timepoint) {
  # Expression matrix
  npx <- data_long %>%
    filter(Assay %in% top_proteins) %>%
    inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
    filter(Subcategory == subcat, Timepoint == timepoint) %>%
    select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Assay, values_from = NPX)

  # Numeric metadata (keep DAid)
  meta <- metadata %>%
    filter(Subcategory == subcat, Timepoint == timepoint) %>%
    select(DAid, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    distinct()

  # Join NPX and metadata
  combined <- inner_join(npx, meta, by = "DAid") %>%
    select(-DAid)  # drop before correlation

  # Remove constant or all-NA columns
  cleaned <- combined %>%
    select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 1)) %>%
    select(where(~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

  return(cleaned)
}

# 4. Generate plots per subcategory and timepoint
cor_plots <- list()
for (timepoint in c("Baseline", "Follow-up")) {
  row_plots <- lapply(subcat_levels, function(subcat) {
    dat <- get_correlation_data(subcat, timepoint)
    if (ncol(dat) < 2) return(NULL)

    cor_mat <- cor(dat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

    ggcorrplot(
      cor_mat,
      hc.order = TRUE,
      type = "lower",
      lab = TRUE,
      lab_size = 2.5,
      title = paste(subcat, "-", timepoint),
      ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 11),
      colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726")
    )
  })
  cor_plots[[timepoint]] <- wrap_plots(row_plots, nrow = 1)
}

# 5. Combine rows into a 2-row layout
final_plot <- (cor_plots$Baseline / cor_plots$`Follow-up`) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Spearman Correlation: Top SII Proteins vs Metadata at Baseline and Follow-up")

# 6. Print or save
print(final_plot)

# Optional: save to file
ggsave(
  filename = "results/figures/figure 5/correlation_heatmaps_baseline_followup.pdf",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 20, height = 10
)

```

```{r ,fig.idth=24, fig.height=20}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# 1. Define top proteins from SII vs Healthy
top_proteins <- sii_healthy_de_res %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Feature)

# 2. Function to get a correlation matrix per timepoint
get_corr_matrix <- function(timepoint_label) {
  meta_sub <- metadata %>%
    filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == timepoint_label) %>%
    select(DAid, where(is.numeric)) %>%
    distinct()

  npx_sub <- data_long %>%
    filter(Assay %in% top_proteins) %>%
    select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Assay, values_from = NPX)

  combined <- inner_join(npx_sub, meta_sub, by = "DAid") %>%
    select(-DAid) %>%
    select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 1 & sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

  cor(combined, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
}

# 3. Compute baseline and follow-up correlation matrices
cor_baseline <- get_corr_matrix("Baseline")
cor_followup <- get_corr_matrix("Follow-up")

# 4. Align variable sets and reorder
shared_vars <- intersect(rownames(cor_baseline), rownames(cor_followup))
cor_baseline <- cor_baseline[shared_vars, shared_vars]
cor_followup <- cor_followup[shared_vars, shared_vars]

# 5. Combine into one matrix
combined_cor <- cor_baseline
combined_cor[upper.tri(combined_cor)] <- cor_followup[upper.tri(combined_cor)]

# 6. Create display number matrix
combined_numbers <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(combined_cor), ncol = ncol(combined_cor),
                           dimnames = dimnames(combined_cor))

combined_numbers[lower.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
  cor_baseline[lower.tri(cor_baseline)], digits = 2, format = "f"
)
combined_numbers[upper.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
  cor_followup[upper.tri(cor_followup)], digits = 2, format = "f"
)

# 7. Define grouping
var_group <- data.frame(
  Group = ifelse(rownames(combined_cor) %in% top_proteins, "Protein", "Clinical")
)
rownames(var_group) <- rownames(combined_cor)

# 8. Define color scale
corr_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"))(100)
corr_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101)

# 9. Optional: define variable order (if desired)
var_order <- rownames(combined_cor)

# 10. Plot the combined heatmap
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  combined_cor[var_order, var_order],
  color = corr_colors,
  breaks = corr_breaks,
  annotation_col = var_group,
  annotation_row = var_group,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  gaps_row = which(diff(as.numeric(as.factor(var_group$Group))) != 0),
  gaps_col = which(diff(as.numeric(as.factor(var_group$Group))) != 0),
  display_numbers = combined_numbers[var_order, var_order],
  number_color = "black",
  number_fontsize = 6,
  main = "Spearman Correlation: Baseline (lower) vs Follow-up (upper)",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8
)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

# 0) Define a function that accepts a vector of Olink proteins
plot_protein_clinical_correlation <- function(protein_vector) {
  # protein_vector: character vector of Olink assay names (e.g., c("CXCL13", "NOS3", ...))

  # 1) Helper to compute a Spearman correlation matrix at a given timepoint
  get_corr_matrix <- function(timepoint_label, proteins) {
    # Subset metadata to HIV patients at the specified timepoint
    meta_sub <- metadata %>%
      filter(Disease == "HIV", Timepoint == timepoint_label) %>%
      select(DAid, where(is.numeric)) %>% 
      distinct()

    # Subset NPX values to the chosen proteins
    npx_sub <- data_long %>%
      filter(Assay %in% proteins) %>%
      select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from  = Assay,
                  values_from = NPX)

    # Inner join clinical (numeric) and NPX measurements
    combined <- inner_join(npx_sub, meta_sub, by = "DAid") %>%
      select(-DAid) %>%
      # drop any column that is constant or almost entirely NA
      select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 1 & sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

    # Compute Spearman correlation
    cor(combined, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  }

  # 2) Compute baseline and follow-up correlation matrices for the input proteins
  cor_baseline <- get_corr_matrix("Baseline", protein_vector)
  cor_followup <- get_corr_matrix("Follow-up", protein_vector)

  # 3) Align variable names between the two matrices
  shared_vars <- intersect(rownames(cor_baseline), rownames(cor_followup))
  cor_baseline <- cor_baseline[shared_vars, shared_vars]
  cor_followup <- cor_followup[shared_vars, shared_vars]

  # 4) Combine into one symmetric matrix: 
  #    lower triangle = baseline correlations, upper triangle = follow-up correlations
  combined_cor <- cor_baseline
  combined_cor[upper.tri(combined_cor)] <- cor_followup[upper.tri(combined_cor)]

  # 5) Create a corresponding display matrix of numbers
  combined_numbers <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(combined_cor), ncol = ncol(combined_cor),
                             dimnames = dimnames(combined_cor))
  combined_numbers[lower.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
    cor_baseline[lower.tri(cor_baseline)], digits = 2, format = "f"
  )
  combined_numbers[upper.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
    cor_followup[upper.tri(cor_followup)], digits = 2, format = "f"
  )

  # 6) Build annotation grouping: Proteins vs remaining clinical variables
  var_group <- data.frame(
    Group = ifelse(rownames(combined_cor) %in% protein_vector, 
                   "Protein", 
                   "Clinical"),
    row.names = rownames(combined_cor)
  )

  # 7) Define a blue-white-red color scale for correlation values
  corr_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"))(100)
  corr_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101)

  # 8) Decide on a display order: all proteins first, then clinical variables
  var_order <- c(
    intersect(protein_vector, rownames(combined_cor)),
    setdiff(rownames(combined_cor), protein_vector)
  )

  # 9) Draw the heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    combined_cor[var_order, var_order],
    color             = corr_colors,
    breaks            = corr_breaks,
    annotation_col    = var_group,
    annotation_row    = var_group,
    annotation_colors = list(Group = c("Protein" = "#A6CEE3", "Clinical" = "#B2DF8A")),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_cols      = FALSE,
    gaps_row          = length(intersect(protein_vector, var_order)),
    gaps_col          = length(intersect(protein_vector, var_order)),
    display_numbers   = combined_numbers[var_order, var_order],
    number_color      = "black",
    number_fontsize   = 6,
    main              = "Spearman Correlation:\nBaseline (lower) vs Follow-up (upper)",
    fontsize_row      = 8,
    fontsize_col      = 8
  )
}

# Example usage: specify the proteins you want to include from Olink
my_proteins <- c("CXCL13", "NOS3", "DPEP2", "FABP5", "CD4", "CD6")

# Call the function to plot
plot_protein_clinical_correlation(my_proteins)
```
